newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper called to open higher, LME closed.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper called to open higher, LME closed.

text.p: COMEX copper was called to open 0.25 to 0.35 cent firmer on Monday with dealings expected to remain fairly quiet as LME was shut due to a public holiday.
The Japanese market was also closed Monday due to a public holiday.
Talks in Chile on Sunday between union leaders and management at the Quebrada Blanca mine failed to resolve the labor dispute and the strike continues.
On Friday COMEX stocks fell 728 short tons to 48,155 tons.
COMEX July copper settled at 110.25 cents per pound on Friday, and traded between 110.60 and 110.55 cents in overnight ACCESS dealings.
